title: mirql Warrant v1
description: Canonical work warrant: the immutable, evidence-backed statement of *what may be changed, why, and at what cost*. Every number in the document must be a safe integer (Law 17); budgets are integer micro-USD.

class.description: Blast-radius class of the work, e.g. `reformat_only`, `surgical`, `expansive`, `investigation`.

semantic_fingerprint.description: SHA-256 over the canonical JSON of the immutable intent statement this warrant executes.

anchors.description: Codebase anchors the warrant is pinned to (paths, spans, tree hashes). Anchoring lets a reviewer verify the work still matches the intent.

evidence.description: Citations, proofs and measurements justifying the warrant; integer-only numbers (Law 17).

red_check.description: Red-team checklist results (cheating vectors reviewed and passed); integer-only numbers (Law 17).

scope.description: Allow/deny path globs and other hard constraints the attempt must stay inside.

budget_micro_usd.description: Hard spend ceiling in integer micro-USD.

phi_budget.description: Owner-authorized complexity growth allowance. Optional for legacy warrants; absence means zero. Bound by the signed warrant hash.

created_by.description: Writer namespace that created the warrant, e.g. `human:owner`.
